# static list for allow_branch and decision categories (checked at load, before subject relations exist)
COLDWAR_UNI_union_tag = {
	OR = { original_tag = SOV original_tag = UKR original_tag = BLR original_tag = EST original_tag = LAT original_tag = LIT original_tag = ARM original_tag = AZE original_tag = GEO original_tag = KAZ original_tag = KYR original_tag = TAJ original_tag = TRK original_tag = UZB original_tag = MLV }
}

# a Union republic inside the Union plan (a Declaration of Sovereignty takes it out)
COLDWAR_UNI_is_republic = {
	COLDWAR_SOV_is_union_republic = yes
	NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_SOV_declaration_of_sovereignty }
	NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UNI_left_union }
}

# who receives the completions of the joint Union tree
COLDWAR_UNI_is_member = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			original_tag = SOV
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_initialized
		}
		COLDWAR_UNI_is_republic = yes
	}
}

# Gorbachev's khozraschet: a failed republic may carry its shortfall itself
COLDWAR_UNI_khozraschet_rule = {
	has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_gensec_gor
	has_completed_focus = COLDWAR_SOV_gor_the_state_enterprise_law
}

# Andropov's discipline: the replacement costs half the political power after exposed pripiski (THIS = SOV, FROM = republic)
COLDWAR_UNI_half_price_replacement = {
	has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_discipline_campaign
	FROM = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UNI_exposed }
}
